# How it was verified

<!--
Not "tests pass" — CI already says that. What did you actually check?

The pipeline ends inside After Effects, so a green test suite proves less here than
in most projects. If your change touches core/xml2ae/, say whether you rebuilt the
.jsx and ran core/verify_jsx.py on it — old .jsx files on disk are NOT regenerated by a code
change, and verifying a stale one proves nothing.
-->

- [ ] `python -m pytest tests -q`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] If it touches AE export: rebuilt `.jsx` and ran `core/verify_jsx.py`
- [ ] If it touches the UI: checked in the browser, console clean

# Checklist

- [ ] I signed the [CLA](../docs/CLA.md) (checked automatically on first PR)
- [ ] No personal data: no absolute paths with a username, no real names, no API keys
- [ ] Added a test if this fixes a bug
- [ ] Comments explain *why*, not *what*
